searchText: Any thoughts on the portmanteau for the Heka + Bogotá hard fork? `Hegotá Hekotá Bogeka Hekogotá Bogáheka Boka` Hegotá seems to be testing well😆 Hekotá, 3 letters from each 👌🏽. I'm a fan of Hektá as well.
